name: Digital 7-Segment LED Display
description: Like a digital alarm clock number! 8 LEDs arranged to illuminate any digit from 0 to 9 plus a decimal point.
realWorldAnalogy: Like a digital alarm clock number! 8 LEDs arranged to illuminate any digit from 0 to 9 plus a decimal point.
wiringGuidance: Connect COM (Dark Slate) to GND through a 220-ohm resistor. Connect segment pins A-G (Green wires) to digital pins 2-8.
commonMistakes: Omitting series current-limiting resistors, damaging the LED segments.
Confusing Common Anode (requires VCC) with Common Cathode (requires GND).

miniExperiment.title: Digital Countdown 0-9
miniExperiment.circuit: COM through 220 ohm to GND, Segments A-G to Pins 2-8.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: The single-digit display clearly counts from 0 through 9 once per second.
